description: Na₂CoH₈(SO₆)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent CoO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 55-66°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.61 Å. Co is bonded to six O atoms to form CoO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 55-66°. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.18 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.73 Å) H-O bond length. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.71 Å) H-O bond length. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CoO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-60°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.51 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na, one Co, and two H atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na, one Co, and two H atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Co and one S atom.
